n43e4d85fa2.headline: Claim of Rs 274 million: Rundheersing Bheenick responds to the State
n43e4d85fa2.summary: Rundheersing Bheenick, former governor of the Bank of Mauritius, is responding to a Rs 274 million damage claim filed against him by the State in the Supreme Court.
n43e4d85fa2.why: Legal disputes involving central bank officials can affect perceptions of governance and financial sector stability in the country.

n41e211ee18.headline: Sunil Jeewoonarain, secretary of Mauritius Bus Owners Cooperative Federation: "I am in favor of a bus ticket price reduction"
n41e211ee18.summary: The secretary of Mauritius Bus Owners Cooperative Federation supports reducing bus ticket prices following a drop in fuel prices, despite the introduction of the Metro Express.
n41e211ee18.why: Transportation costs affect consumer spending and inflation in Mauritius's economy.

n2ed27d1aa5.headline: Inflation accumulates a 49.3% year-on-year increase
n2ed27d1aa5.summary: Argentina's inflation accumulated 49.3% year-on-year, with January seeing a 2.9% increase, notably in communication, restaurants, and hotels.
n2ed27d1aa5.why: High inflation erodes purchasing power and affects monetary policy, investment decisions, and consumer behavior in Argentina.
